title: Clark County key ceremony script
note: DRAFT pending independent security review and the outside auditor's sign-off. The Ceremony Administrator (CA) reads each SAY line aloud. The Internal Witness (IW) confirms, timestamps and initials each step. Nothing secret is ever read aloud, shown or written down: only steps, serial numbers, hashes and public-key fingerprints.
abort_rule: Any bag-serial mismatch, hash mismatch, missing quorum, or unexplained event stops the ceremony. Record an exception, the outside auditor rules, and if in doubt the ceremony is rescheduled. Nobody improvises.

steps.say: This is ceremony {ceremony_id}, on {date}, at {location}. Recording and the public livestream are starting now.
steps.check: System Administrator confirms every camera and the livestream are live. IW writes the start time.

steps.say: We will now verify the room and the attendee list.
steps.check: Every attendee is on the published list, shows ID and signs in. At least 3 Crypto Officers (activation-card holders) from different institutions are present.
steps.abort_if: Fewer than 3 Crypto Officers, or anyone in the room who isn't on the list.

steps.say: We will now confirm the previous ceremony's bag-serial record is on hand and the safes show no sign of tampering.
steps.check: The IW holds the printed bag-serial record from the last ceremony (registry 'check' report). Both safes are inspected for damage.
steps.abort_if: The record is missing, or a safe shows damage.

steps.say: Safe Controller 2 will open the credentials safe. Each Crypto Officer will open their card lockbox with the county key and their own key. Each card bag's serial will be read aloud.
steps.check: For each card bag: the serial matches the last sealed serial and the bag is intact. Record each one with 'teb open'.
steps.abort_if: Any serial mismatch or damaged bag.

steps.say: Safe Controller 1 will open the equipment safe. Each equipment bag's serial will be read aloud before it is opened.
steps.check: For each equipment bag (hardware module, laptop, OS disc, write-once media): the serial matches and the bag is intact. Record each one with 'teb open'.
steps.abort_if: Any serial mismatch or damaged bag.

steps.say: We will boot the offline laptop from the read-only disc. I will read the disc's hash aloud.
steps.check: The laptop has no internal storage, wireless or network hardware (visually confirmed). The disc hash read aloud matches the hash in the pre-ceremony package.
steps.abort_if: Hash mismatch, or any storage or radio hardware present.

steps.say: We will verify every artifact brought into the room against its published hash.
steps.check: Each artifact on write-once media passes 'verify' against the pre-ceremony package.

steps.say: Three Crypto Officers will now activate the hardware module with their cards.
steps.check: Three cards from three different institutions are used. Each officer enters their own PIN privately on the shielded keypad; no PIN is spoken.
steps.abort_if: Activation fails, or cards from the same institution are used.

steps.say: We will now perform the ceremony actions listed in the pre-ceremony package. For each one, I will read the resulting public-key fingerprint or signature fingerprint aloud.
steps.check: Only the listed actions are performed (generate, pin, sign). The IW writes each fingerprint as read. No secret material is displayed.
steps.abort_if: Any action not on the published list, or any secret material displayed.

steps.say: The hardware module will now be deactivated, and each Crypto Officer will take back their card.
steps.check: The module reports deactivated. Each card is back with its officer.

steps.say: Every item will now be sealed in a new tamper-evident bag. Each new serial will be read aloud.
steps.check: Every item goes in a NEW bag. The IW writes each new serial. Record each with 'teb seal'.
steps.abort_if: A bag serial that has been used before.

steps.say: The safe controllers will return the items to the safes, and each Crypto Officer will lock their card in its lockbox.
steps.check: Each safe controller logs every item returned. Both safes are closed and locked.
steps.abort_if: An item can't be accounted for.

steps.say: All participants will now sign the Internal Witness's script. This ends ceremony {ceremony_id}.
steps.check: Every participant signs. The IW writes the end time. Recording stops after the signatures.
